_comment: Was a SET_FLAG plus a STATIC using PAY_OR_DAMAGE — an unrelated effect — for a COST REDUCTION. 'Your next attack this turn that targets Arakni costs {r} less' is a one-shot on the play-time queue. The Arakni-target restriction is NOT modelled: the queue filters on the card being played, and who it will target is not known then. Stated because it makes the reduction more permissive than printed.
